description: Time-travel query: the article corpus as it stood at a past date, meaning only the articles BCA had ingested by as_of, optionally narrowed by a search query and an entity slug. Useful for backtesting and audit trails. Free, and works without an API key. Answers unseeded when nothing matches.

as_of.description: ISO 8601 timestamp: corpus state at this date.

name: get_as_of_snapshot
